g_ir.name: all_pairs_gap_sigmoid_scaled
g_ir.intuition: Vectorized weighting of all pairs by a sigmoid of the positive gap with configurable sigmoid center and sharpness, clamped to ensure nonnegativity and no per-instance normalization, preserving dense all-pair topology.
g_ir.code:
def generated_builder(feature_cache, extra):
    objective = feature_cache['objective']
    mask = objective[:, :, None] < objective[:, None, :]
    b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx = mask.nonzero(as_tuple=True)
    gap = objective[b_idx, loser_idx] - objective[b_idx, winner_idx]
    beta = float(extra.get('weight_beta', 1.5))
    tau = float(extra.get('weight_tau', 3.0))
    weight_raw = (gap - beta) * tau
    weight_sig = weight_raw.sigmoid()
    weight = weight_sig.clamp(min=0.25, max=3.0)
    return PrefBatch(mode='pairwise', pair_idx=(b_idx, winner_idx, loser_idx), weight=weight, meta={'builder': 'all_pairs', 'weight_family': 'gap_sigmoid_scaled_clamped'})
